subject: ArmVirtPkg: Add library for Arm CCA initialisation in PEI
reasons: This commit adds a brand new library (ArmCcaInitPeiLib) with new header and implementation files. It is a new code addition, not a transformation of existing code.
There is no existing pattern being matched and replaced; Coccinelle cannot express 'add new files containing new functions'.
The change consists of entirely new C and INF files with no analogous structural change to existing call sites.
